content: | T-S7 | Join onto someone's screen uninvited, then receive their photos | Tap a matching join tab at the same moment as the real person. Or place a tile next to theirs in the mini-map. Once joined, photos dropped into the space would be fetched by themselves (F11) | A1 | M | H | | C15 (who joined and on which side, with Undo), C16 (the other device must accept), F11 (nothing is fetched by itself until the join has settled (accepted or 10 s with no Undo); only prints dropped after that) |
